title: Umphefumlo Oxabisekileyo Owabuza Igunya
intro: Kwiingxelo zeQuran, bekukho umntu owayenobutyebi nolwazi oluye lwaba yintsomi. Lo mphefumlo waphuma emhlabeni unezihombiso nobutyebi obabumangalisa ababukeli, kodwa intliziyo yabo yakhukhumala ngenxa yokuzingca. Joyina nathi njengoko sityhila imfihlakalo yenye yeentsomi ezilumkisayo zeQuran, apho ubukhulu bezinto eziphathekayo bufikelela esiphelweni esithobekileyo phantsi komhlaba owazala ubutyebi babo.
clues: Ndaphuma emhlabeni ndihonjiswe ngezinto zokuhombisa ezazitsala amehlo omntu wonke.
Ndandinobutyebi obukhulu nolwazi olunzulu olwalundenza ndahluke kwabanye.
Xa kufika umthunywa ebiza abantu ku-Allah, ndabuza igunya labo ngekratshi.
Abo babendingqongile babesithi inceba ka-Allah ayingomthombo wobutyebi bam.
Abantu bam bamangaliswa bubukhulu bam baza banqwenela ikamva elifana nelam.
Izakhiwo zam ezintle zaginywa zaphela emhlabeni njengesohlwayo sikaThixo.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Uginywe ngumhlaba nazo zonke izinto onazo
outcome.answer: Uginywe ngumhlaba nazo zonke izinto onazo

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
